name: Vardis
source:
"I'm proud to say I'm even more devoted to women's lives."

A priest of the Holy Order, devoted to the Five Pillars.

Though his duty is to serve the Order, he often prioritizes protecting women’s lives and well-being, giving him an impression of being carefree—or even flirtatious.

In truth, he is a hard-working soul constantly being swept along by Jeanne and her companions.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
